cmd: set -e; D=/opt/trading-bot/genetic; cd /opt/weather-pipeline/repo; git fetch -q origin; git show origin/main:bot/genetic/genetic.py > $D/genetic.py; mkdir -p $D/confl $D/confl_short; cp $D/index.html $D/confl/index.html; cp $D/index.html $D/confl_short/index.html; chown -R tbot:tbot $D; su -s /bin/sh tbot -c "cd $D && nohup sh -c \"GEN_OUT=$D/confl GEN_POP=200 GEN_GENS=40 GEN_NOISE=3 GEN_WORKERS=2 nice -n 19 /opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python genetic.py > run_confl.log 2>&1; GEN_TFS=15m,30m GEN_OUT=$D/confl_short GEN_POP=200 GEN_GENS=40 GEN_NOISE=3 GEN_WORKERS=2 nice -n 19 /opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python genetic.py > run_confl_short.log 2>&1\" > /dev/null 2>&1 &"; sleep 40; tail -2 $D/run_confl.log | cut -c1-250
